text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Seiun Sky—
I suddenly snapped awake on the train.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... *Mumble*...
'Morning...

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text: "‘Next stop, final stop—’"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The last stop...?
...Wait, where am I?

We both overslept and ended up at the final stop,
so we decided to take a stroll until the next train back.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Taking a stroll in an unfamiliar place
makes it really feel like a trip, huh~
choice_data_list: Were we even on a journey...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's not sweat the small stuff♪
Let's just take it easy until the train arrives.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear me... What is that...?
Could it be...?
Having spotted something, Seiun Sky started running with her back to the sea—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, would you look at that...!
Now that's some fine work~!"

Upon catching up with Seiun Sky,
you found her intently admiring a giant rock...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The top is nice and flat, looks comfy to sleep on~♪
The sound of the waves is so soothing, you'd sleep like a baby~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The glare from the sea in summer, and the chilly winds in winter are a bit of a flaw...
Having to pick the right time of day docks a few points, I'd say~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, this has two-star potential!
I might just add it to Sei-chan's
"Top Secret Nationwide Nap Map."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe.
I'm so glad you asked.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This book is a collection of nap spots I discovered while out and about.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With this map, you can quickly rejuvenate
your body anywhere~.
choice_data_list: In other words, a collection of slacking-off spots...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds awful when you put it like that~
Well, I won't deny it, though."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now then. My estimate says two stars, but let's see if this rock really is a good sleeping spot—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'll go to sleep and find out. Here goes, good night...!
If I let her fall asleep now, we'll miss the train!
choice_data_list: You can't sleep any more than this!
You can't sleep any more than this!
I'll try it for you instead!

text_block_list.text: If I let her fall asleep now, we'll miss the train!
choice_data_list: You can't sleep any more than this!
You can't sleep any more than this!
I'll try it for you instead!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Telling me not to sleep is like telling a gourmet not to eat, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Two hours... no, couldn't you spare even three hours?
choice_data_list: You're going to miss your train.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I totally forgot.
We've gotta hurry back to the station.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A harmony of plush seats and gentle swaying.
Some call it 'the running lullaby'...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heading off to a 3-star nap spot——
The "train"♪

It looks like she intends to sleep like a log on the train ride home as well.
I silently vowed to stay wide awake so that we wouldn't both sleep past our stop again...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho.
Testing how comfortable it is in my stead, are you...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I just got curious about what it feels like
to sleep on a seaside rock, you see~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san, could you please
leave a review in my place~?
I'll give a review that satisfies Seiun Sky here and head to the station right away.

...The sound of the waves is lulling me to sleep.
I cannot afford to fall asleep here, but...
choice_data_list: T-This is bad... At this rate...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, 'mornin'~.
Or wait, it's dark out already, so maybe good 'night'~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That looked like it felt amazing~♪
Looks like my instincts were spot on after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! While you were sleeping, Trainer, I found another spot that looks great for a nap.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wanna try that one too?

I managed to persuade Seiun Sky, who still wanted
to stroll around, and we headed for the station...
